richiami.difetto: A small batch of semi-trailers were supplied with an incorrect airspring support plate. This could result in a reduction in trailer roll performance.
richiami.rimedio: The operators of the subject semi-trailers are being advised of the situation and supplied with correctly specified airspring support plates for retro-fitment to the trailer suspension. Operators to advise ROR when the plates have been fitted.

richiami.difetto: The hub bearings in some TE 9000 axles may be liable to premature failure. If not detected this could result in hub seizure or wheel and hub detachment.
richiami.rimedio: Supply sufficient replacement hubs and bearings to all operators of affected trailers and monitor the return rate of displaced units to ensure full coverage of the vehicle parc.

richiami.difetto: The weld attaching the stub axle to the suspension arm may fail resulting in collapse and displacement of the suspension
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected semi-trailers and replace the suspension arms with quality assured examples.
